# Step 1: Fetch all songs in Spotify song library (dedupe by song_id)
song_details = {}  # song_id -> (title, artists_str)
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
song_lib_count = 0

while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_song_library(
        access_token=spotify_token,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    if not page:
        break
    for s in page:
        song_id = s['song_id']
        title = s.get('title','')
        artists_str = '|'.join(a['name'] for a in (s.get('artists') or []))
        if song_id not in song_details:
            song_details[song_id] = (title, artists_str)
        song_lib_count += 1
    page_index += 1

print('song_library_pages_fetched', page_index)
print('song_library_rows_seen', song_lib_count)
print('unique_songs_in_song_library', len(song_details))

    page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(
        access_token=spotify_token,
        page_index=playlist_page_index,
        page_limit=playlist_page_limit
    )
    if not page:
        break
    for p in page:

# Fetch details for missing songs using show_song

    sdet = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    title = sdet.get('title','')
    artists_str = '|'.join(a['name'] for a in (sdet.get('artists') or []))
    song_details[sid] = (title, artists_str)
    fetched_missing += 1

print('fetched_missing', fetched_missing)
print('final_unique_songs_export', len(song_details))

import os

# Build CSV content from existing song_details

def csv_escape(val):
    s = '' if val is None else str(val)
    s = s.replace('"','""')
    if any(c in s for c in [',','\n','\r','"']):
        return '"'+s+'"'
    return s

items = []
for sid,(title,artists_str) in song_details.items():
    items.append((title,artists_str,sid))
# Deterministic ordering
items.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0].lower(), x[1].lower(), x[2]))

lines = ['Title,Artists']
for title,artists_str,sid in items:
    lines.append(csv_escape(title)+','+csv_escape(artists_str))
content = '\n'.join(lines)+'\n'

file_path = '~/backups/spotify_songs.csv'
dir_path = '~/backups'

# Check/create directory
print('dir_exists_before', apis.file_system.directory_exists(directory_path=dir_path, access_token=fs_token))

    # Only create if missing
    create_res = apis.file_system.create_directory(directory_path=dir_path, access_token=fs_token, recursive=False)
    print('create_directory_res', create_res)
else:
    print('skip_create_directory')

file_exists = apis.file_system.file_exists(file_path=file_path, access_token=fs_token)
print('file_exists_before', file_exists)

if file_exists:
    upd_res = apis.file_system.update_file(file_path=file_path, content=content, access_token=fs_token)
    print('update_file_res', upd_res)
else:
    create_res = apis.file_system.create_file(file_path=file_path, content=content, access_token=fs_token)

# Verification (single pass)

lines_ver = file_content.splitlines()

print('header', header)
row_count = max(0, len(lines_ver)-1)
print('row_count_verified', row_count)
print('expected_rows', len(song_details))
